blocks.h2: Signs Your Sump Pump Is Failing
blocks.intro: Check yours before the next storm:

tiles.h3: It Hums but the Water Stays
tiles.body: The motor runs but the impeller is jammed or worn.

tiles.h3: It Turns On and Off Constantly
tiles.body: A bad float switch or a check valve letting water fall back into the pit.

tiles.h3: Rust, Corrosion or a Burning Smell
tiles.body: Signs the motor is wearing out.
If the power fails during a storm, so does your only pump.

blocks.intro: In July 2017, more than 7 inches of rain fell just south of Elgin over two days, and basements flooded across the area.

items.body: The storms that fill sump pits also knock out power. A battery backup keeps pumping when the main pump stops.
Many homes built before 1940 had a sump pit added decades later, often small and shallow. If the pump cycles nonstop, the pit may be part of the problem.
A west side home from the 1990s or 2000s may still have its builder-grade pump. Most last about 7 to 10 years.
A short or frozen discharge line sends water right back to the foundation. We route it where it drains.

blocks.h2: Sump Pump Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: How do I test my sump pump?
items.preview: Pour a bucket of water into the pit and watch it run.
items.answer: Pour a bucket or two of water into the pit. The pump should start, empty the pit and shut off. If it doesn't, call us before the next storm.

items.q: What's the best battery backup sump pump?
items.preview: One sized to your pit and inflow, with a good battery and an alarm.
items.answer: The best backup is one sized to how much water comes into your pit, with a quality battery and an alarm that tells you it's running. We'll recommend one for your basement.

items.q: How long does a sump pump last?
items.answer: Most sump pumps last somewhere around 7 to 10 years, and less if they run often.

items.q: Why does my sump pump run in winter?
items.answer: Snowmelt and rain on frozen ground can keep groundwater high. A pump running in winter isn't unusual, but a frozen discharge line can make it overflow.

items.q: How much does sump pump replacement cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on the pump, pit and backup. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, the pit and check valve and whether you add a backup. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
